top5.title: The UK can no longer conceal its request for Apple data
top5.description: The UK was forced to make public its requests to obtain a backdoor into iCloud encryption. The relevant court sided with Apple over holding the case in public.
top5.why: The UK’s forced disclosure of its request for an Apple iCloud encryption backdoor is a major test of end-to-end encryption, government surveillance powers and user trust.

top5.title: A widespread malware attack targeted iPhone and iPad users
top5.description: Malicious code inserted on more than 170 sites through an Optimizely vulnerability attempted to steal bank card and cryptocurrency data. iPhone and iPad users were exposed to Coruna and DarkSword exploit kits.
top5.why: A widespread campaign exploiting more than 170 compromised websites to target iPhone and iPad users highlights a serious and active threat to mobile financial and cryptocurrency security.

top5.title: Gemini can now handle multistep everyday tasks
top5.description: Google has expanded Gemini’s Tasks mode to perform tasks such as scheduling appointments, reviewing bills and placing grocery orders. The service asks for confirmation before certain critical steps, but Google recommends checking the results.
top5.why: Gemini’s ability to execute multistep real-world tasks such as appointments, bill reviews and grocery orders signals a shift from chatbots toward consumer AI agents.

top5.title: The Model Context Protocol connects AI applications to data and tools
top5.description: The Model Context Protocol is presented as an open standard for connecting AI applications to personal data and tools, like a USB-C port for AI.
top5.why: The Model Context Protocol’s role as an open standard for connecting AI systems to data and tools could become foundational infrastructure for enterprise AI interoperability.

top5.title: OpenAI turns written briefs into playable 3D experiences with Astra
top5.description: GPT-6.2 Astra can turn a written brief into an interactive browser experience, such as a playable pinball game or an explorable Colosseum. OpenAI says the model leads a human-evaluated 3D benchmark.
top5.why: OpenAI’s Astra demonstrates models generating playable 3D experiences from written briefs, potentially lowering the cost and expertise required to create software, games and simulations.
